title: Proximal: MedlinePlus Medical Encyclopedia
content: Proximal Proximal means nearer to the center (trunk of the body) or to the point of attachment to the body. If another reference point is given, such as the heart, the proximal point of another organ or extremity is the point closest to the heart, central rather than peripheral . Proximal is the opposite of distal . Images Anatomical landmarks adult - back Anatomical landmarks adult - front view References Taber's Cyclopedic Medical Dictionary. 24th ed. Philadelphia, PA: F.A.
